subject: WRAP UP: stop at 07:50
body: Hard stop for the night run at 08:00. Finish what you are doing, make sure your owned files compile/tests pass or are left in the last passing state, commit/save, write your honest STATUS.md (implemented / tested with output / unresolved), post DONE <id> on the board by 07:50. Delete large test outputs. After 07:50 the supervisor will stop your session.
